phase_name: Thread cycle_budget_advisory onto both dispatch-row sites

objectives.description: Re-read orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh immediately before editing; audit every consumer of the dispatch row for exhaustive key enumeration (orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh, skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md, orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh) before adding the field
objectives.note: grep for to_entries, keys, with_entries, and fixed-field destructuring of a .dispatch[] element in all three consumers: zero hits in any of the three. orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh and skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md both read dispatch-row fields exclusively via `jq -r .task`/`.phase`/`.agent`/`.model`/`.force`/`.dispatch_file` (named-field reads, never exhaustive key enumeration) -- see SKILL.md's own explicit MUST NOT ('no field of a dispatch[] row is ever forwarded as an Agent-tool argument unless this section names it as one'). orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh has zero matches at all for any dispatch-row-reading pattern -- it COMPOSES a dispatch file from flag arguments; it never reads an existing dispatch[] row. No fourth consumer was discovered. Safe to add the additive field: no consumer enumerates keys exhaustively.

notes: Verification: bash -n clean; shellcheck -S warning zero findings (same as Phase 1 baseline).
